about: ClipDeck Reel shelf. The monthly adverts batch takes the first entry with used_in = null, shows it to Mike with the batch, and after his yes schedules it as an Instagram/Facebook Reel (and Threads video), then sets used_in to the month (e.g. '2026-11') and commits.
